flow.title: The bid you win becomes the plan you build.
flow.lead: Nothing is typed twice. The locations you measure are the locations you price, plan and control.
flow.s1.title: Measure
flow.s1.text: Calibrate the drawings, map blocks, zones and rooms, and take off walls, ceilings, structure and MEP.
flow.s2.title: Price
flow.s2.text: Recipes turn quantities into materials and labor hours, priced from your dated price book and labor rates.
flow.s3.title: Win & convert
flow.s3.text: Send the proposal PDF with the takeoff attached. A won bid becomes a project, with its baseline and work packages.
flow.s4.title: Plan
flow.s4.text: Master plan by location, lookahead, constraints, and a weekly plan that only commits ready work.
flow.s5.title: Execute & learn
flow.s5.text: Daily reports and attendance feed estimate vs. actual: progress, earned value, productivity and cost.
est.title: Estimating that speaks Brazil and the USA.
est.lead: Use RitsuFlow only for takeoff and estimating, or connect it to planning. The same price engine reproduces the TCU BDI formula and US markup stacks.
est.b1.text: with a separate BDI for materials and taxes on the price.
est.b2.text: general conditions, overhead, profit, bond and sales tax.
est.b3.text: dated price book, CSV import and an ABC curve.
est.b4.text: with allowances, alternates and your clause library.
est.b5.text: win rate by client and project type, markup of won vs. lost bids.
est.card.title: Price build-up · BDI (TCU)
lean.title: Commit only what is ready.
lean.lead: RitsuFlow checks Make Ready conditions before an activity enters the weekly plan. Constrained work stays visible, but it cannot be committed until its constraints are cleared.
lean.shotAlt: RitsuFlow weekly planning: an activity that is ready can become a weekly commitment.
control.title: Know where the estimate held — and where it didn't.
control.c1.title: Daily reports & attendance
control.c1.text: Production by activity, workforce, materials received and check-in / check-out hours from the field.
control.c2.title: Earned value & productivity
control.c2.text: Progress per estimate line, earned hours against hours worked, and a productivity index for each project.
control.c3.title: Actual cost vs. budget
control.c3.text: Import costs from your ERP or spreadsheet and see CPI and cost variance by line and category.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1.title: Who we are
privacy.s1.text: RitsuFlow™ is developed and commercialized by ExcelisPro, Ponta Grossa, PR, Brazil, which controls the personal data described here under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law 13.709/2018).
privacy.s2.title: What we collect on this site
privacy.s2.text: When you apply for the trial: your name, work email, company, country, role, number of active projects, the modules you want to try and the language of the page. We do not use advertising cookies or trackers on this page.
privacy.s3.title: Why and on what basis
privacy.s3.text: Only to evaluate your application and contact you about the RitsuFlow trial, based on your consent (LGPD art. 7, I). You can withdraw consent at any time.
privacy.s4.title: Where it is stored and for how long
privacy.s4.text: In RitsuFlow's database, hosted by Supabase, with access restricted to ExcelisPro. We keep applications for up to 24 months after the trial ends, or less if you ask us to delete them. We do not sell or share your data.
privacy.s5.title: Your rights
privacy.s5.text: You can ask to confirm, access, correct, anonymize, port or delete your data, and to withdraw consent (LGPD art. 18). Write to the contact below; we answer within 15 days.
privacy.s6.title: Contact for data requests
scope.title: Measure on the drawing. See it in 3D.
scope.lead: Calibrate the PDF, draw walls, ceilings, floors and openings by type, and RitsuScope computes areas, lengths and the framing — studs, tracks and boards — level by level.
scope.shot1Alt: RitsuScope takeoff: walls by type drawn on the calibrated sheet, doors deducted and quantities per level.
scope.shot2Text: Printed to PDF with every wall tagged by type, and attached to the proposal in one click.
scope.shot2Alt: RitsuScope 3D view of the walls, tagged by type, as printed to PDF.
scope.shot3Text: Studs at the specified spacing, openings and junctions, shown in 3D and counted in the material list.
scope.shot3Alt: RitsuScope 3D framing view with studs, openings and rooms.
